Class XmlRecordType

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.session.io.xml.v2_1.XmlRecordType
public class XmlRecordType extends Object
 <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><a xmlns="https://phon.ca/ns/session" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" href="https://phon-ca.github.io/phon/phon-manual/session_editor/records.html">Phon manual section on this topic...</a>

Java class for recordType complex type.

The following schema fragment specifies the expected content contained within this class. 

 <complexType name="recordType">
   <complexContent>
     <restriction base="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}anyType">
       <sequence>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}orthography"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}ipaTarget" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}ipaActual" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}alignment" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}segment" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}notes" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}userTier" maxOccurs="unbounded" minOccurs="0"/>
       </sequence>
       <attribute name="speaker" type="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}IDREF" />
       <attribute name="id" type="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}ID" />
       <attribute name="excludeFromSearches" type="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}boolean" default="false" />
     </restriction>
   </complexContent>
 </complexType>

    • getUserTier

      public List<XmlUserTierType> getUserTier()
      Gets the value of the userTier property.

      This accessor method returns a reference to the live list, not a snapshot. Therefore any modification you make to the returned list will be present inside the Jakarta XML Binding object. This is why there is not a set method for the userTier property.

      For example, to add a new item, do as follows: 

          getUserTier().add(newItem);

      Objects of the following type(s) are allowed in the list XmlUserTierType
